name: Infantry_Desktop
author: Infantry AI
description: A desktop layout: a plain wallpaper with an icon for the orchestrator and one for Apps. The orchestrator opens full screen in exactly its usual layout, with an app title bar to minimize it back to the desktop or close it. A taskbar along the bottom shows each open app; the orchestrator's entry carries how many agents work and how many need you. The start layout of a device that has not chosen one. Replaceable: any layout plugin can take its place.
